name: Science Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public scientific research data.

entries.title: CERN Open Data Portal
entries.description: Petabyte-scale open access to particle-physics datasets, software, and documentation from CERN's LHC experiments (ALICE, ATLAS, CMS, LHCb, and others), released for research and education.

access.auth_note: Some derived research/analysis tools require a free CERN Open Data account; raw dataset browsing and download do not.

coverage.spatial: global (international collaboration; hosted at CERN, Switzerland/France)

entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: NIH RePORTER
entries.description: NIH's searchable database of federally funded biomedical research projects — awards, investigators, organizations, funding amounts, and linked publications and patents — with an API and the ExPORTER bulk downloads.

coverage.spatial: United States (NIH and other HHS-funded research, worldwide recipients)

entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The site renders only with JavaScript; headless Chromium shows the RePORTER search with links to FAQs, the API, and ExPORTER. The old ExPORTER URL https://report.nih.gov/exporter returned 404 to headless Chromium, so the bulk-download location should be confirmed by a steward. Two things are assumed from RePORTER's usual description and weren't checked: the weekly cadence and the inclusion of other HHS agencies' projects.
